name: Automated Full-Charge Disconnect Guard
author: Jiu Shi Long Xia
description: Zero-dependency shell watchdog that toggles charging input switches upon reaching 100% and automatically reconnects power when charge drops to 95%.

seo.title: Automated Full-Charge Disconnect Guard for Magisk & KernelSU
seo.description: Prevent battery overcharging and high-voltage stress by cutting charging input at 100% and resuming at 95% automatically.
